verdict.rationale: Reflect documents a custom URL scheme (reflect://reflect?command=...) for performing actions from outside the app, but the only documented command appends text to today's daily note. Its REST API (OAuth2, POST /graphs/{graphId}/notes) can create notes from scripts. Opening a specific note via a deep link is not evidenced, and there is no local endpoint. missing for 10: a documented deep-link command to create or open a specific note, a full list of deep-link commands, a local endpoint, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the app from outside — create or open notes via a URI scheme, deep links, or a local endpoint — to wire it into my scripts and workflows

citations.quote: Reflect supports deep linking, allowing users to perform actions within the app using custom URLs.
Appends text to the first list in today's daily note. This one only takes one argument, `text`.
